construction-transport.json.scope: Finite complete-reference comparison of bounded construction/source/type transport. One-page source/type/record/index caches. No new kernel judgments or independent archive membership. Browser behavior and whole-process memory have separate evidence.

constructionTransportControls.scope: Transport, source/interface, identity and lifecycle controls; not independent kernel or native archive membership verification. The mismatch boundary is a synthetic altered projection, not a new native judgment.

typeTransportControls.scope: Codec, identity, scope, cache and cancellation checks; no new typing or general consumer correctness theorem

typeQueryControls.scope: Authenticated transport and finite profile membership/absence; not independent native archive membership or kernel checking

historicalTypeModel.scope: Independent finite model comparison of paged computed type geometry; browser integration and whole-browser memory have separate evidence

producers.scope: Existing compiled term/type/construction metadata only; no new native queries or private mathematical source modules.

regressions.json.scope: Finite model and transport controls. Historical type model deliberately retains its original 26-profile subset. No new native Lean execution.
